title: Hara Castle: The Rebellion That Closed Japan for Two Hundred Years
summary: Recounts how, in the winter of sixteen thirty-seven to thirty-eight, peasants in Kyushu living under crushing taxes and anti-Christian persecution rose up behind a sixteen-year-old boy and sealed themselves inside the abandoned Hara Castle, and the hundred-day siege they withstood against a shogunal army of one hundred twenty-five thousand. The episode also reaches the Dutch ship de Ryp, which shelled the castle from the sea at the shogun's request, the slaughter of thirty-seven thousand people, the only feudal lord beheaded in the Edo period, and Japan's two-hundred-year closure.
